steps.en: Revival marks old suspensions as revived and keeps them
steps.id: Revival menandai suspension lama sebagai di-revive dan menyimpannya

steps.en: The notice record no longer shows the revived suspension
steps.id: Record notice tidak lagi menampilkan suspension yang di-revive

steps.en: Reduced amounts return, but only under some conditions
steps.id: Jumlah hasil reduction dikembalikan, tapi hanya pada kondisi tertentu
steps.why_en: The amount is restored only if an original value exists, and a failed restore is not reported.
steps.why_id: Jumlah dikembalikan hanya bila nilai asli ada, dan kegagalan pengembalian tidak dilaporkan.

steps.en: Processing resumes through later jobs, not directly
steps.id: Pemrosesan lanjut lewat job berikutnya, bukan langsung
steps.why_en: Revival does not reset the next processing date; resuming depends on a later job.
steps.why_id: Revival tidak mengatur ulang tanggal proses berikutnya; lanjutnya bergantung pada job berikutnya.
